gate_definitions.G0_scope_and_inputs_documented: Pilot scope and inputs are documented, signed.
gate_definitions.G1_pilot_user_acknowledgement: Pilot user identified and acknowledgement signed.
gate_definitions.G2_pilot_data_loaded: Pilot data loaded; non-pilot data excluded.
gate_definitions.G3_pilot_environment_isolated: Pilot environment isolated; no production / customer / NDA data accessible.
gate_definitions.G4_pilot_run_window_defined: Pilot run window defined: start_date, end_date, hours_of_operation.
gate_definitions.G7_support_incident_response_in_place: Support and incident response in place (support_and_incident_response.md).
gate_definitions.G8_evidence_storage_with_retention: Pilot artifacts storage with retention policy defined.
gate_definitions.G9_exit_criteria_defined: Exit criteria defined (success and failure per runbook §7).
gate_definitions.G10_no_go_acknowledgement: No-go claim list acknowledged by every pilot user and operator.

gate_transitions.pending_to_passed: Each gate moves pending -> passed when the pilot operator records evidence_path, completed_at, completed_by, and notes. Status values: pending, in_progress, passed, failed, blocked, not_applicable.
gate_transitions.pilot_start_authorized: Pilot start is authorized only when all gates G0-G10 are in status: passed. Any other status (failed, blocked, pending, in_progress) blocks pilot start.

global_notes: This checklist is empty at package creation. It is the gate tracker for pilot start. Every gate must be in status 'passed' before the pilot can start.

The 11 gates mirror the 10-item setup checklist in the B7 runbook §2 plus the no-go acknowledgement (gate G10). The runbook's checklist is the human-readable form; this file is the machine-readable form.
Cross-check pilot_claim_allowed per area in reports/validation/validation_evidence_matrix.json. Areas where pilot_claim_allowed is false are out of pilot scope.
A pilot is internal validation with a real human in the loop. It does not produce external claims of any kind. See docs/external_review/no_go_claims.md for the full no-go scope.
